findings.detail: The graph transformation itself implements the stated symmetric edge weighting, row normalization, train-only input, unit normalization, and residual mixing. However the implementation hard-codes only GRAPH_LAMBDA=0.1 and exposes no way to fit/export the specified 0.3 and 0.5 candidates for validation selection. This does not implement the prescribed lambda candidate experiment/selection protocol.
findings.reproduction: Run the trainer or call denoise_with_train_transitions without an explicit strength: it always uses 0.1. There is no candidate loop or output/config path for 0.3 or 0.5.
findings.correction: Run the unchanged tokenizer fit/export for each lambda in {0.1,0.3,0.5}, keeping all other configuration fixed, and apply the predeclared validation selection protocol; do not use validation edges/statistics to construct the graph.
